protocol.analysis_status: Exploratory follow-up motivated by the seed1 horizon result (large K1 loss, recovery at K15). The four comparisons below were specified before any settling scores were observed; this is not an overall preregistered study.
protocol.primary: Four paired score-gap contrasts for default depths: repeat15 minus K1, repeat60 minus K1, repeat15 minus chronological K15, repeat60 minus chronological K60. Holm t and exhaustive sign flips separately; display all per-model scores and paired population-gap intervals. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.
protocol.design: All branches follow common full Grid controller until first discovery. Each model then controls its own path. Every repeat branch zeros h/c at each decision and applies that decision input identically 15 or 60 times; only the final output selects one physical action. No chronological input sequence is replayed. All frozen weights, native spatial codes, external saved goal, previous action/reward and image remain available.
protocol.retained: Repeating the full current input also repeats its previous-action and previous-reward channels, including arrival reward just after pickup. Those values are not replaced or suppressed.
caveats: Repeated current inputs are a constructed, potentially unfamiliar controller; success does not prove the native model never uses history.

Recovery would show that the advantage can operate without chronological recent inputs under this construction. Failure remains ambiguous between missing useful history and abnormal state initialization/updates.
Both h/c are recomputed each physical decision, but the external saved goal and previous action/reward still contain past information.
Repeating inputs changes internal computation depth per physical action and may itself create useful state; it does not identify the computation learned during training.
Full PGC begins from common Grid discovery experience. No neural states transfer between models.

statistics: Eight training-seed pairs. Means and t95 intervals use training seeds as independent units. Four exploratory-follow-up score-gap contrasts receive Holm correction separately for paired-t and exact two-sided sign flips. Other intervals/contrasts are descriptive, not tests of equivalence.
